title: Player momentum (experimental, unwitnessed)
summary: Adjust fast turning and ordinary braking, with an optional bounded running-start contact bonus.

backend.command: python3 -c "import importlib, sys; from pathlib import Path; module = importlib.import_module(sys.argv[1][:-3].replace('/', '.')); payload, receipt = module.apply(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes()); Path(sys.argv[3]).open('xb').write(payload); print(receipt)" mod_editor/core/nfl2k5_momentum.py <source.xbe> <new-copy.xbe>

gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. Opt in manually after protected build integration; all presets default off.

input_constraints: Pinned USA retail hook/table bytes and supported XBE geometry; all spans and section digests validated.
Integer level 0..100; contact requires a positive level; all presets retail/off.
Combined named grown allocation requests chosen before installing any owner; rebuild to change settings.
Ordinary running only for braking/contact history; special states fall back to retail. Legacy rating ramp must be off for parity witnesses.
portme: Integrate and test both orders with the absent defensive-try owner.
Witness cuts, stop-and-go, contact, catches, pursuit, both controllers and CPU movement.

public_distribution.rule: Ship source and recipes; never distribute the generated game executable or disc.

runtime.scope: Bounded Unicorn hooks and deterministic retail resolver fixtures passed. Loader, animation assets, gameplay feel and full tackle reactions remain unwitnessed.

fields.name: momentum_contact
fields.allowed: Boolean, default false; true requires momentum > 0

selectors.notes: The two controls share one configured executable owner. Exact zero adds no Momentum hooks or history.

source_container.retail_file: user-owned default.xbe in an NFL 2K5 USA disc
source_container.resource: ordinary turn curve, pinned locomotion/contact hooks, named grown RX/RW allocations
